about: The Collect of the feast of the Most Holy Body of Christ. It asks for such veneration of the mysteries of the Lord's Body and Blood that their reception may continually yield the fruit of redemption.

seg.tr: O God, who hast left us under a wondrous Sacrament the memorial of Thy Passion, grant us, we beseech Thee, so to venerate the sacred mysteries of Thy Body and Blood that we may continually feel within us the fruit of Thy redemption, who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
